ex.en: You have to get this work finished by noon.
ex.zh: 你必須在中午前完成這項工作。

ex.en: The train is due to arrive at noon.
ex.zh: 火車預定中午抵達。

ex.en: Tell him to call me tomorrow at noon.
ex.zh: 叫他明天中午打電話給我。

noon.en: twelve o'clock in the middle of the day

ex.en: He notified the police of the traffic accident.
ex.zh: 他向警方通報了這起車禍。

ex.en: Please fill out this form and wait for us to notify you.
ex.zh: 請填好這張表格，等候我們通知。

ex.en: If there's a better solution, then I'll notify you about it as soon as possible.
ex.zh: 如果有更好的解決方案，我會盡快通知您。

notify.en: to officially tell someone about something

ex.en: She was nominated for Employee of the Year.
ex.zh: 她被提名為年度最佳員工。

ex.en: The film was nominated for three awards.
ex.zh: 這部電影入圍了三個獎項。

nominate.en: to suggest someone formally for a prize or an election

ex.en: Each team should nominate one person to attend the meeting.
ex.zh: 每個團隊應指派一人出席會議。

ex.en: The board nominated Amy as the new director.
ex.zh: 董事會任命 Amy 為新任主管。

nominate.en: to choose someone for a job or a task

ex.en: It's noisy around here, so speak a little louder.
ex.zh: 這裡有點吵，請說大聲一點。

ex.en: It is too noisy around here; I can't concentrate.
ex.zh: 這裡太吵了，我沒辦法專心。

ex.en: Our neighbors are very noisy at night.
ex.zh: 我們的鄰居晚上很吵。

noisy.en: making a lot of loud sounds

ex.en: The film received five Oscar nominations.
ex.zh: 這部電影獲得五項奧斯卡提名。

ex.en: Nominations for the award close on Friday.
ex.zh: 這個獎項的提名於週五截止。

nomination.en: an official suggestion that someone should get a prize or a job

non.zh: 非、不（多作字首，如 non-profit 非營利）

ex.en: The prefix "non" means "not," as in non-smoking.
ex.zh: 字首「non」表示「非、不」，例如 non-smoking（禁菸）。

ex.en: Add "non" to "profit" and you get non-profit.
ex.zh: 在 profit 前面加上 non，就變成 non-profit（非營利）。

non.en: a word part meaning not, added to the start of a word

ex.en: He is the nominal head of the company.
ex.zh: 他是公司名義上的負責人。

ex.en: Her role on the board is purely nominal.
ex.zh: 她在董事會的角色純屬名義上的。

nominal.en: existing in name only, and not in fact

ex.en: We charge a nominal fee for delivery.
ex.zh: 我們只收取象徵性的運費。

ex.en: The museum charges a nominal entrance fee.
ex.zh: 博物館只收取少許入場費。

nominal.en: very small, and much less than the real value

ex.en: Nominal GDP grew by 4 percent.
ex.zh: 名目國內生產毛額成長了百分之四。

ex.en: The nominal interest rate does not include inflation.
ex.zh: 名目利率沒有考慮通膨因素。

nominal.en: measured in money value without taking price changes into account

ex.en: Prices rose in many areas, notably in Taipei.
ex.zh: 許多地區房價上漲，尤其是台北。

ex.en: Sales were notably higher this year.
ex.zh: 今年的銷售額明顯較高。

notably.en: especially, or in a way that is easy to see

ex.en: Each computer is a node in the network.
ex.zh: 每台電腦都是網路中的一個節點。

ex.en: The data is stored on several nodes.
ex.zh: 資料儲存在好幾個節點上。

node.en: a point in a system where lines meet or where data is handled

ex.en: Accepting the other's norms is submitting to the other's power.
ex.zh: 接受對方的規範，就是屈服於對方的權力。

ex.en: Working from home has become the norm.
ex.zh: 在家工作已成為常態。

ex.en: Social norms differ from country to country.
ex.zh: 社會規範因國家而異。

norm.en: a usual way of behaving, or a rule that most people follow

ex.en: Carrefour's Ham offcuts are not expensive at all, but are nonetheless delicious.
ex.zh: 家樂福的火腿邊角料一點都不貴，卻還是很好吃。

ex.en: The task was difficult; nonetheless, we finished on time.
ex.zh: 任務很困難，儘管如此，我們還是準時完成了。

ex.en: It was raining. Nonetheless, the event went ahead.
ex.zh: 當時在下雨，儘管如此，活動還是照常舉行。

nonetheless.en: in spite of what has just been said

notable.zh: 值得注意的、顯著的、著名的

ex.en: There has been a notable increase in online sales.
ex.zh: 網路銷售有顯著的成長。

ex.en: The city is notable for its night markets.
ex.zh: 這座城市以夜市聞名。

notable.en: important or interesting enough to be noticed

ex.en: I do not have an account in these forums.
ex.zh: 我在這些論壇上沒有帳號。

ex.en: I'm not sure about the price.
ex.zh: 我不太確定價格。

not.en: used to make a word or sentence negative

ex.en: "Will it rain tomorrow?" "I hope not."
ex.zh: 「明天會下雨嗎？」「希望不會。」

ex.en: If not, please let me know.
ex.zh: 如果不行，請告訴我。

not.en: used to give a negative answer without repeating a whole sentence

not.zh: not only … but also：不但…而且

ex.en: She is not only smart but also hardworking.
ex.zh: 她不但聰明，而且很努力。

ex.en: The hotel is not only cheap but also clean.
ex.zh: 這家飯店不但便宜，而且很乾淨。

not.en: used to show that two things are both true

not.zh: not at all：一點也不；（回應道謝）不客氣

ex.en: I'm not at all tired.
ex.zh: 我一點也不累。

ex.en: "Thanks for your help." "Not at all."
ex.zh: 「謝謝你的幫忙。」「不客氣。」

not.en: in no way, or used to politely answer thanks

ex.en: I have no more time to talk with you.
ex.zh: 我沒有時間再跟你聊了。

ex.en: There is no milk in the fridge.
ex.zh: 冰箱裡沒有牛奶。

ex.en: No, thank you. I'm full.
ex.zh: 不用了，謝謝，我吃飽了。

ex.en: No, I don't think so.
ex.zh: 不，我不這麼認為。

no.en: used to give a negative answer or refuse

ex.en: No smoking is allowed in the office.
ex.zh: 辦公室內禁止吸菸。

ex.en: The sign says no parking.
ex.zh: 告示上寫著禁止停車。

no.en: used on signs to show that something is not allowed

ex.en: If I don't do it now, I never will.
ex.zh: 如果我現在不做，就永遠不會做了。

ex.en: My son can count up to a hundred now.
ex.zh: 我兒子現在會數到一百了。

ex.en: It's already eleven o'clock. I must be leaving now.
ex.zh: 已經十一點了，我現在得走了。

ex.en: Start right now, and you'll catch up with them.
ex.zh: 你現在馬上出發，就能趕上他們。

ex.en: I've got my friend on the line right now.
ex.zh: 我現在正在跟朋友講電話。

ex.en: Now that you're here, let's start.
ex.zh: 既然你來了，我們就開始吧。

ex.en: Now that I have a car, I can drive to work.
ex.zh: 既然我有車了，就可以開車上班。

now.en: used to give a reason based on a new situation

ex.en: This box is empty. It has nothing in it.
ex.zh: 這個箱子是空的，裡面什麼都沒有。

ex.en: As far as I know, he did nothing wrong.
ex.zh: 據我所知，他沒做錯任何事。

ex.en: On entering a dark tunnel, we could see nothing.
ex.zh: 一進入漆黑的隧道，我們什麼都看不見。

ex.en: There was nothing but a desk in his room.
ex.zh: 他房間裡只有一張書桌。

ex.en: He drinks nothing but coffee in the morning.
ex.zh: 他早上只喝咖啡。

nothing.zh: have nothing to do with：與…無關

ex.en: This has nothing to do with you.
ex.zh: 這跟你無關。

ex.en: His decision had nothing to do with money.
ex.zh: 他的決定跟錢沒有關係。

ex.en: I'd like to borrow your notes for a bit.
ex.zh: 我想跟你借一下筆記。

ex.en: I'll keep the meeting notes to review them before the next session.
ex.zh: 我會保留會議筆記，下次開會前再複習。

note.en: words written down to help you remember something

ex.en: Tom left a note for Mary on her desk.
ex.zh: 湯姆在瑪麗桌上留了一張紙條給她。

ex.en: There was a note on my desk in Tom's handwriting.
ex.zh: 我桌上有一張湯姆手寫的紙條。

ex.en: The students noted down every word the teacher said.
ex.zh: 學生們把老師說的每個字都記了下來。

ex.en: Please note down your order number.
ex.zh: 請記下您的訂單編號。

note.en: to write something down so you do not forget it

ex.en: Please note that the office will be closed on Monday.
ex.zh: 請注意，辦公室星期一不開放。

ex.en: Note that prices may change.
ex.zh: 請留意價格可能會變動。

note.en: to pay attention to a fact and remember it

ex.en: Korean food is noted for its spicy flavor.
ex.zh: 韓國菜以辣聞名。

ex.en: The city is noted for its night markets.
ex.zh: 這座城市以夜市聞名。

note.en: to be well known because of a special quality

ex.en: No one noticed her absence until the meeting ended.
ex.zh: 直到會議結束都沒人注意到她不在。

ex.en: Tom didn't notice that Mary had a new hairstyle.
ex.zh: 湯姆沒注意到瑪麗換了新髮型。

notice.en: to see or become aware of something

ex.en: The store is closed until further notice.
ex.zh: 商店暫停營業，直到另行通知。

ex.en: Tom gave his two weeks' notice yesterday.
ex.zh: 湯姆昨天提出兩週後離職的通知。

notice.en: a warning given before something happens or ends

ex.en: Please read the notice on the board.
ex.zh: 請看公布欄上的公告。

ex.en: A notice was posted at the entrance.
ex.zh: 入口處貼了一張公告。

notice.en: a written sign or announcement for people to read

ex.en: She took no notice of what her father said.
ex.zh: 她完全不理會父親說的話。

ex.en: He never takes any notice of what his father says.
ex.zh: 他從不理會父親說的話。

ex.en: Traffic conditions on the highway are normal this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上高速公路的交通狀況正常。

ex.en: It's normal to be a little afraid.
ex.zh: 有點害怕很正常。

ex.en: He's just a normal junior high school student, not particularly intelligent.
ex.zh: 他只是個普通的國中生，不算特別聰明。

ex.en: The man's body temperature is higher than normal.
ex.zh: 這個男人的體溫比正常高。

ex.en: Things will soon return to normal.
ex.zh: 情況很快就會恢復正常。

normal.en: the usual or average level or condition

ex.en: None of them would admit to being the culprit.
ex.zh: 他們沒有一個人承認自己是犯人。

ex.en: None of them could understand what she was implying.
ex.zh: 他們沒有人聽懂她在暗示什麼。

ex.en: None of the rooms were available.
ex.zh: 沒有任何空房。

none.en: not one person or thing, or not any

none.zh: none of your business：不關你的事

ex.en: In any case, it's none of your business.
ex.zh: 總之，這不關你的事。

ex.en: Where I go is none of your business.
ex.zh: 我去哪裡不關你的事。

none.en: used to say that something is private and you do not want to discuss it

none.zh: second to none：首屈一指、不輸任何人

ex.en: Yamada is second to none in English in his class.
ex.zh: 山田的英文在班上首屈一指。

ex.en: Their customer service is second to none.
ex.zh: 他們的客戶服務首屈一指。

ex.en: Tom meant it as a joke, but nobody laughed.
ex.zh: 湯姆只是開玩笑，但沒有人笑。

ex.en: Nobody had the courage to say it to him.
ex.zh: 沒有人有勇氣跟他說。

ex.en: Nobody can prevent this plan from being carried out.
ex.zh: 沒有人能阻止這個計畫執行。

ex.en: Ten years ago, he was a nobody in the music business.
ex.zh: 十年前他在音樂界還是個無名小卒。

ex.en: She went from a nobody to a famous actress.
ex.zh: 她從無名小卒變成知名女演員。

nobody.en: a person who is not important or famous

ex.en: Canada is to the north of the United States.
ex.zh: 加拿大位於美國北方。

ex.en: There was a cold wind blowing from the north.
ex.zh: 一陣冷風從北方吹來。

ex.en: Keelung is in the north of Taiwan.
ex.zh: 基隆在台灣北部。

north.en: the direction that is on your left when you face the rising sun

ex.en: To reach the North Pole is not easy.
ex.zh: 要抵達北極並不容易。

ex.en: Canada is on the north side of America.
ex.zh: 加拿大在美國的北邊。

north.en: in or toward the direction opposite to south

ex.en: The road runs north along the coast.
ex.zh: 這條路沿著海岸往北延伸。

ex.en: We drove north to Taichung.
ex.zh: 我們往北開到台中。

north.en: toward the direction opposite to south

ex.en: This novel is too difficult for me to read.
ex.zh: 這本小說對我來說太難讀了。

ex.en: I spent the whole day in reading the novel.
ex.zh: 我花了一整天看這本小說。

ex.en: My brother would often stay up all night reading novels.
ex.zh: 我哥哥常常熬夜看小說。

novel.en: a long written story about imaginary people and events

ex.en: That's a novel idea!
ex.zh: 那是個新奇的點子！

ex.en: The company took a novel approach to marketing.
ex.zh: 這家公司採用了新穎的行銷方式。

novel.en: new and different from what is usual

ex.en: Normally, I stay at home on Sundays.
ex.zh: 我星期天通常待在家。

ex.en: A sentence normally has a subject and a verb.
ex.zh: 一個句子通常有主詞和動詞。

ex.en: Normally I might study Chinese characters for an hour a day.
ex.zh: 我平常每天大概練一個小時的漢字。

ex.en: The system is working normally again.
ex.zh: 系統已恢復正常運作。

ex.en: Try to breathe normally.
ex.zh: 盡量正常呼吸。

normally.en: in the usual or correct way

ex.en: I can't put up with that noise any longer.
ex.zh: 我再也受不了那個噪音了。

ex.en: Noises interfered with my studying.
ex.zh: 噪音干擾了我讀書。

ex.en: It's not possible to study with so much noise!
ex.zh: 這麼吵根本沒辦法讀書！

noise.en: a sound, especially a loud or unpleasant one

ex.en: I have no notion of how this machine works.
ex.zh: 我完全不知道這台機器是怎麼運作的。

ex.en: The notion that money buys happiness is wrong.
ex.zh: 認為金錢能買到快樂的觀念是錯的。

ex.en: He rejected the notion of working overtime.
ex.zh: 他不接受加班的想法。

notion.en: an idea or belief about something

ex.en: The city is at the northern end of Japan.
ex.zh: 這座城市位於日本的最北端。

ex.en: Japan is located in the Northern Hemisphere.
ex.zh: 日本位於北半球。

ex.en: Norway, located in Northern Europe, is a highly developed country.
ex.zh: 挪威位於北歐，是高度發展的國家。

northern.en: in or from the north part of a place

ex.en: She pressed her nose against the sheet of glass.
ex.zh: 她把鼻子貼在玻璃上。

ex.en: Your noses are bleeding.
ex.zh: 你們的鼻子在流血。

ex.en: I have a cold and my nose is running.
ex.zh: 我感冒了，一直流鼻水。

nose.en: the part of the face used for smelling and breathing

nose.zh: poke one's nose into：多管閒事、干涉

ex.en: My father is always poking his nose into my private life.
ex.zh: 我爸總是干涉我的私生活。

ex.en: Stop poking your nose into my business.
ex.zh: 別再管我的事了。

nose.en: to become involved in something that is not your business

ex.en: Nowadays many people travel by car.
ex.zh: 現在很多人開車旅行。

ex.en: Nowadays, almost every home has one or two televisions.
ex.zh: 現在幾乎每個家庭都有一兩台電視。

ex.en: Without an air conditioner, people nowadays cannot live.
ex.zh: 現在的人沒有冷氣就活不下去。

nowadays.en: at the present time, compared with the past

ex.en: He said he had nowhere to go.
ex.zh: 他說他無處可去。

ex.en: My keys are nowhere to be found.
ex.zh: 我的鑰匙怎麼找都找不到。

ex.en: After three hours of discussion we got nowhere.
ex.zh: 我們討論了三個小時，卻毫無進展。

ex.en: Prolonging the discussion will bring us nowhere.
ex.zh: 繼續討論下去也不會有結果。

nowhere.zh: in the middle of nowhere：在偏僻荒涼的地方

ex.en: I live in the middle of nowhere.
ex.zh: 我住在一個很偏僻的地方。

ex.en: Our car broke down in the middle of nowhere.
ex.zh: 我們的車在荒郊野外拋錨了。

nowhere.en: in a place far from towns and other people

ex.en: In this case, the adjective goes before the noun.
ex.zh: 在這種情況下，形容詞放在名詞前面。

ex.en: Is this word a noun or a verb?
ex.zh: 這個字是名詞還是動詞？

ex.en: Adjectives describe nouns.
ex.zh: 形容詞用來修飾名詞。

noun.en: a word that names a person, place, thing, or idea

ex.en: It was a noble decision to donate the money.
ex.zh: 捐出這筆錢是個高尚的決定。

ex.en: Helping others is a noble goal.
ex.zh: 幫助別人是崇高的目標。

noble.en: good and honest in a way that people respect

ex.en: Your sister looks as noble as if she were a princess.
ex.zh: 你妹妹看起來好高貴，就像公主一樣。

ex.en: She comes from a noble family.
ex.zh: 她出身貴族世家。

noble.en: belonging to a high social class, or looking very dignified

ex.en: Generally speaking, nobles were only very slightly affected by taxes.
ex.zh: 整體來說，貴族受稅賦的影響非常小。

ex.en: The castle once belonged to a wealthy noble.
ex.zh: 這座城堡曾屬於一位富有的貴族。

noble.en: a person born into the highest social class

ex.en: The relationship between price and demand is nonlinear.
ex.zh: 價格和需求之間是非線性的關係。

ex.en: This software supports nonlinear video editing.
ex.zh: 這套軟體支援非線性影片剪輯。

nonlinear.en: not following a straight line or a simple steady pattern

ex.en: Musical notation can be hard to learn.
ex.zh: 樂譜記號可能很難學。

ex.en: Scientific notation makes large numbers easier to write.
ex.zh: 科學記號讓很大的數字更容易書寫。

notation.en: a system of signs and symbols used to write down things like music or math

ex.en: When it comes to love, women are experts and men eternal novices.
ex.zh: 說到愛情，女人是專家，男人永遠是新手。

ex.en: This course is designed for novices.
ex.zh: 這門課是為初學者設計的。

ex.en: As a novice, I made many mistakes in my first week.
ex.zh: 身為新手，我第一週犯了很多錯。

novice.en: a person who is new to an activity and has little experience

ex.en: I have a friend whose father is a famous novelist.
ex.zh: 我有個朋友，他的父親是知名小說家。

ex.en: He is not a poet but a novelist.
ex.zh: 他不是詩人，而是小說家。

ex.en: My friend's father is a famous novelist.
ex.zh: 我朋友的父親是一位有名的小說家。

novelist.en: a person who writes long stories for a living

ex.en: He prefers nonfiction, especially books about history.
ex.zh: 他比較喜歡非小說類的書，尤其是歷史書。

ex.en: The library has separate shelves for fiction and nonfiction.
ex.zh: 圖書館的小說和非小說類書籍分開擺放。

nonfiction.en: writing about real facts and events

ex.en: This junction is notorious for accidents.
ex.zh: 這個路口因頻繁的事故而臭名昭著。

ex.en: Ms. Eichler had a notorious reputation for being austere to her students.
ex.zh: 艾希勒女士對學生嚴厲是出了名的。

ex.en: The old photographs filled him with nostalgia.
ex.zh: 那些老照片讓他充滿懷舊之情。

ex.en: She felt a wave of nostalgia for her school days.
ex.zh: 她對學生時代湧起一陣懷念之情。

nostalgia.en: a warm feeling when you think about happy times in the past

ex.en: The truth and simplicity of nature is always the most important foundation of noteworthy art.
ex.zh: 大自然的真實和質樸往往是值得注意的藝術中最重要的基石。

ex.en: Her most noteworthy achievement was doubling the company's sales.
ex.zh: 她最值得一提的成就是讓公司的銷售額翻倍。

ex.en: Nothing noteworthy happened at the meeting.
ex.zh: 這次會議沒有發生什麼值得注意的事。

noteworthy.en: interesting or important enough to deserve attention

ex.en: I didn't mean to be nosy.
ex.zh: 我沒想多管閒事。

ex.en: My nosy neighbor always asks who comes to visit our house.
ex.zh: 我那個愛打聽的鄰居總是問誰來我們家拜訪。

nosy.en: too interested in other people's private lives

ex.en: There are noticeable differences between the two.
ex.zh: 兩者之間有顯著的差別。

ex.en: There was a noticeable change in his attitude after the trip.
ex.zh: 那趟旅行之後，他的態度有了明顯的轉變。

ex.en: Her English has improved in a very noticeable way.
ex.zh: 她的英文進步得非常明顯。

noticeable.en: easy to see or to pay attention to

ex.en: In the past, only the nobility could afford such fine clothes.
ex.zh: 過去只有貴族才買得起這麼高級的衣服。

ex.en: The king invited members of the nobility to the royal wedding.
ex.zh: 國王邀請貴族們參加皇室婚禮。

nobility.en: the group of people in the highest social class

ex.en: Everyone admired the nobility of her decision to forgive him.
ex.zh: 大家都很欽佩她決定原諒他的高尚情操。

ex.en: There is a quiet nobility in helping others without asking for thanks.
ex.zh: 默默幫助別人而不求回報，是一種高尚的品格。

nobility.en: the quality of being good and honest in a way that people respect

ex.en: You need to have the contract notarized.
ex.zh: 你需要把合約拿去公證。

ex.en: The documents were notarized by a lawyer.
ex.zh: 這些文件經過律師公證。

notarize.en: to have a legal paper officially checked and signed by an authorized person

ex.en: You will receive a notification when the order ships.
ex.zh: 訂單出貨時您會收到通知。

ex.en: The system sent a notification to all staff.
ex.zh: 系統已向所有員工發出通知。

notification.en: a message or statement that gives you information

ex.en: Each nominee for the director role was interviewed by the board.
ex.zh: 董事會面試了每一位主管職位的提名人選。

ex.en: The award nominee was notified before the public announcement.
ex.zh: 獎項入圍者在公開宣布前就接到了通知。

nominee.en: a person who has been suggested for a prize or a job

ex.en: Her notice period ends at the end of the month.
ex.zh: 她的離職預告期在月底結束。

ex.en: Please confirm the required notice period with human resources.
ex.zh: 請向人資確認所需的預告期間。

notice period.en: the time between telling an employer you will quit and your last day of work

ex.en: Are we making a nonstop flight to the U.S.?
ex.zh: 我們搭的是直飛美國的航班嗎？

ex.en: After a nonstop shift, the nurses took turns resting.
ex.zh: 連續值班後，護理師輪流休息。

nonstop.en: without stopping on the way, or without a break

ex.en: I don't like coffee, nor do I like tea.
ex.zh: 我不喜歡咖啡，也不喜歡茶。

ex.en: Neither he nor his sister came to the party.
ex.zh: 他和他妹妹都沒有來參加派對。

ex.en: She nodded to show that she agreed.
ex.zh: 她點頭表示同意。

ex.en: He nodded at me when I walked in.
ex.zh: 我走進去時，他向我點了點頭。

ex.en: He gave me a quick nod and smiled.
ex.zh: 他對我快速點了點頭並微笑。

ex.en: A nod from the teacher meant we could start.
ex.zh: 老師點個頭就表示我們可以開始了。

ex.en: Grandpa nodded off in front of the TV.
ex.zh: 爺爺在電視前打起盹來。

ex.en: I nearly nodded off during the long lecture.
ex.zh: 在冗長的演講中我差點睡著。

ex.en: The storm is moving toward the northwest.
ex.zh: 風暴正往西北方移動。

ex.en: They live in the northwest of the country.
ex.zh: 他們住在這個國家的西北部。

ex.en: A cold northwest wind blew all night.
ex.zh: 冷冷的西北風整晚都在吹。

ex.en: The northwest corner of the room is the warmest.
ex.zh: 房間西北角最溫暖。

ex.en: We drove northwest for about two hours.
ex.zh: 我們開車往西北走了大約兩小時。

ex.en: The birds flew northwest over the lake.
ex.zh: 鳥群飛越湖面朝西北方向飛去。

ex.en: She works for a nonprofit organization that helps children.
ex.zh: 她在一個幫助兒童的非營利組織工作。

ex.en: The nonprofit group collects old clothes for families in need.
ex.zh: 這個非營利團體為需要的家庭收集舊衣服。

ex.en: Don't talk nonsense; you know that's not true.
ex.zh: 不要胡說，你知道那不是真的。

ex.en: He dismissed the rumor as complete nonsense.
ex.zh: 他把那個謠言當作完全是胡說八道。

ex.en: The instructions were total nonsense to me.
ex.zh: 這份說明對我來說完全看不懂。

ex.en: The poem is just fun nonsense for children.
ex.zh: 這首詩只是給孩子的有趣無厘頭作品。

ex.en: The storm is moving toward the northeast.
ex.zh: 暴風雨正朝東北方移動。

ex.en: The village lies in the northeast of the country.
ex.zh: 這個村莊位於該國的東北部。

ex.en: A northeast wind brought cold air to the island.
ex.zh: 東北風為島上帶來冷空氣。

ex.en: They live in the northeast part of the city.
ex.zh: 他們住在城市的東北區。

ex.en: The ship sailed northeast along the coast.
ex.zh: 那艘船沿著海岸向東北航行。

ex.en: Birds flew northeast over the hills.
ex.zh: 鳥群向東北飛過山丘。

ex.en: I wrote the phone number in my notebook.
ex.zh: 我把電話號碼寫在筆記本裡。

ex.en: She always carries a small notebook in her bag.
ex.zh: 她包包裡總是帶著一本小筆記本。

ex.en: He bought a light notebook for work trips.
ex.zh: 他買了一台輕便的筆電出差用。

ex.en: My notebook battery only lasts three hours.
ex.zh: 我的筆電電池只能撐三個小時。

ex.en: The days get shorter in November.
ex.zh: 十一月白天變得比較短。

ex.en: We will take a trip in November.
ex.zh: 我們十一月要去旅行。

ex.en: Her birthday is on the twentieth of November.
ex.zh: 她的生日是十一月二十日。

ex.en: The old castle was built in the Norman style.
ex.zh: 這座古堡是以諾曼式風格建造的。

ex.en: Many Norman soldiers crossed the sea to England in 1066.
ex.zh: 許多諾曼士兵在一〇六六年渡海前往英格蘭。

nottingham.zh: 諾丁漢（英格蘭的郡與城市）

ex.en: Nottingham is a city in the middle of England.
ex.zh: 諾丁漢是英格蘭中部的一座城市。

ex.en: The legend of Robin Hood is linked to Nottingham.
ex.zh: 羅賓漢的傳說與諾丁漢有關。

ex.en: Norwich is a city in the east of England.
ex.zh: 諾威奇是英格蘭東部的一座城市。

ex.en: Norwich has an old cathedral and a castle.
ex.zh: 諾威奇有一座古老的大教堂和一座城堡。

ex.en: Norway is a country in northern Europe.
ex.zh: 挪威是北歐的一個國家。

ex.en: Many people travel to Norway to see the northern lights.
ex.zh: 許多人到挪威去看極光。

ex.en: Norfolk is a county in the east of England.
ex.zh: 諾福克是英格蘭東部的一個郡。

ex.en: Norwich is the largest city in Norfolk.
ex.zh: 諾威奇是諾福克最大的城市。

ex.en: They live in a small town in the northwestern part of the country.
ex.zh: 他們住在國家西北部的一個小鎮。

ex.en: A northwestern wind brought cold air to the city.
ex.zh: 西北風為這座城市帶來冷空氣。

ex.en: He studied at a university in a northeastern city.
ex.zh: 他在東北部的一座城市念大學。

ex.en: Heavy snow hit the northeastern part of the country.
ex.zh: 大雪襲擊了這個國家的東北部。

ex.en: The novelty of living abroad soon wore off.
ex.zh: 住在國外的新鮮感很快就消退了。

ex.en: Snow was a novelty for the children.
ex.zh: 雪對孩子們來說很新奇。

ex.en: The shop sells novelty gifts and toys.
ex.zh: 這家店賣新奇的小禮物和玩具。

ex.en: The talking toy was a real novelty at the time.
ex.zh: 那個會說話的玩具在當時是很新奇的東西。

ex.en: I had a bowl of beef noodle soup for lunch.
ex.zh: 我午餐吃了一碗牛肉湯麵。

ex.en: Cook the noodle for about five minutes, then drain it.
ex.zh: 把麵條煮大約五分鐘，然後瀝乾。

ex.en: We ate Norwegian salmon for dinner.
ex.zh: 我們晚餐吃了挪威鮭魚。

ex.en: She wants to see the Norwegian coast by boat.
ex.zh: 她想搭船欣賞挪威的海岸線。

ex.en: My teacher is a Norwegian who lives in Taipei.
ex.zh: 我的老師是住在台北的挪威人。

ex.en: He is learning Norwegian before his trip.
ex.zh: 他在出發前學習挪威語。

ex.en: The book sets out a normative view of how people should behave.
ex.zh: 這本書提出了一套關於人應該如何行為的規範性觀點。

ex.en: Normative rules guide how we behave in public.
ex.zh: 規範性的準則引導我們在公共場合的行為。

ex.en: Linguists argue about normative grammar.
ex.zh: 語言學家對規範語法的看法有爭論。

ex.en: The cold air stung her nostrils.
ex.zh: 冷空氣刺痛了她的鼻孔。

ex.en: A horse's nostrils open wide when it runs.
ex.zh: 馬奔跑時鼻孔會張得很大。

ex.en: He pinched one nostril and blew his nose.
ex.zh: 他壓住一邊的鼻孔擤鼻涕。

ex.en: The road is notoriously dangerous in winter.
ex.zh: 這條路在冬天是出了名的危險。

ex.en: He is notoriously late for every meeting.
ex.zh: 他每次開會都是出了名的遲到。

ex.en: The city's traffic is notoriously bad.
ex.zh: 這座城市的交通出了名的糟。

ex.en: The company's customer service is practically nonexistent.
ex.zh: 那家公司的客服幾乎等於不存在。

ex.en: He kept worrying about a nonexistent problem.
ex.zh: 他一直在擔心一個根本不存在的問題。

ex.en: Public transportation is nonexistent in this small village.
ex.zh: 這個小村莊沒有任何公共交通。

normandy.zh: 諾曼第（法國西北部地區）

ex.en: Normandy is a region in northern France.
ex.zh: 諾曼第是法國北部的一個地區。

ex.en: We visited Normandy and saw its beautiful coastline.
ex.zh: 我們去了諾曼第，欣賞了它美麗的海岸線。

ex.en: Notwithstanding the heavy rain, the game continued.
ex.zh: 儘管下著大雨，比賽仍繼續進行。

ex.en: The plan went ahead, notwithstanding some objections.
ex.zh: 儘管有一些反對意見，計畫還是照常進行。

ex.en: The weather was bad; we enjoyed the trip notwithstanding.
ex.zh: 天氣很糟，但我們還是玩得很開心。

ex.en: He was tired, but he kept working notwithstanding.
ex.zh: 他累了，但還是照樣工作。

ex.en: The old card read 'Joyeux Noel' in beautiful handwriting.
ex.zh: 那張舊卡片上用漂亮的字跡寫著「Joyeux Noel」。

ex.en: The choir sang a Noel at the end of the evening.
ex.zh: 合唱團在晚會結尾唱了一首聖誕頌歌。

ex.en: Three noughts follow the number one in a thousand.
ex.zh: 一千這個數字在1後面有三個零。

ex.en: All our hard work came to nought.
ex.zh: 我們所有的努力都化為烏有。

ex.en: He cut a notch in the stick to mark the spot.
ex.zh: 他在木棍上刻了一個缺口來標記位置。

ex.en: The belt has a notch for each size.
ex.zh: 這條皮帶每個尺寸都有一個刻痕。

ex.en: Her cooking is a notch above the restaurant's.
ex.zh: 她的廚藝比那家餐廳高出一個檔次。

ex.en: The hotel service was top-notch, and we'll come back.
ex.zh: 這家飯店的服務一流，我們會再來。

ex.en: “Do you want more cake?” “Nope, I'm full.”
ex.zh: 「想再吃點蛋糕嗎？」「不用了，我飽了。」

ex.en: Nope, I haven't seen your keys.
ex.zh: 沒有，我沒看到你的鑰匙。

ex.en: She took a nontraditional path to becoming a teacher.
ex.zh: 她走了一條非傳統的路來成為老師。

ex.en: The restaurant serves nontraditional versions of classic dishes.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳提供經典菜色的非傳統版本。

ex.en: They organized a nonviolent protest in the square.
ex.zh: 他們在廣場上舉辦了一場非暴力抗議。

ex.en: The group promised to use only nonviolent methods.
ex.zh: 該團體承諾只使用非暴力的方式。

nobel.zh: 諾貝爾（瑞典發明家，設立諾貝爾獎）

ex.en: Alfred Nobel was a Swedish inventor who created the Nobel Prizes in his will.
ex.zh: 阿弗雷德·諾貝爾是瑞典發明家，他在遺囑中設立了諾貝爾獎。

ex.en: The Nobel Prize in Physics is awarded every year in Stockholm.
ex.zh: 諾貝爾物理學獎每年在斯德哥爾摩頒發。

ex.en: Fresh fruit and vegetables nourish the body.
ex.zh: 新鮮蔬果滋養身體。

ex.en: The mother worked hard to nourish her children.
ex.zh: 母親努力工作來養育她的孩子們。

ex.en: Good teachers nourish a child's curiosity.
ex.zh: 好老師會培養孩子的好奇心。

ex.en: He nourished a dream of becoming a pilot for many years.
ex.zh: 他多年來一直懷抱著成為飛行員的夢想。

ex.en: Many nongovernmental groups helped after the earthquake.
ex.zh: 許多非政府組織在地震後提供了協助。

ex.en: She works for a nongovernmental organization that protects the oceans.
ex.zh: 她在一個保護海洋的非政府組織工作。

ex.en: The old songs made him feel nostalgic.
ex.zh: 這些老歌讓他覺得很懷舊。

ex.en: She felt nostalgic for her hometown.
ex.zh: 她很懷念自己的家鄉。

ex.en: She is a noted author who has written ten novels.
ex.zh: 她是知名作家，已寫了十本小說。

ex.en: The town is noted for its hot springs.
ex.zh: 這個小鎮以溫泉聞名。

noted.zh: 指出；注意到（note 的過去式）

ex.en: The teacher noted that he had improved a lot this year.
ex.zh: 老師指出他今年進步了很多。

ex.en: I noted the time and wrote it down in my diary.
ex.zh: 我留意了時間，並把它寫進日記裡。

ex.en: The air felt noticeably colder after sunset.
ex.zh: 日落後，空氣明顯變冷了。

ex.en: He was noticeably nervous before the speech.
ex.zh: 演講前他明顯很緊張。

ex.en: Life slowly returned to normality after the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨過後，生活慢慢恢復正常。

ex.en: The doctor was pleased to see a sign of normality in the test results.
ex.zh: 醫生很高興看到檢查結果顯示一切正常。

ex.en: The birds fly northwards in the spring.
ex.zh: 鳥兒在春天往北飛。

ex.en: We drove northwards along the coast.
ex.zh: 我們沿著海岸往北開。

ex.en: I bought a nonstick pan so the eggs won't stick.
ex.zh: 我買了一個不沾鍋，這樣蛋就不會黏鍋。

ex.en: The nonstick surface is easy to clean.
ex.zh: 不沾的表面很容易清洗。

ex.en: In the Bible, Noah built a large ark before the flood.
ex.zh: 在聖經裡，諾亞在洪水來臨前建造了一艘大方舟。

ex.en: The story of Noah is told in many cultures.
ex.zh: 諾亞的故事在許多文化中流傳。

ex.en: Many countries signed a nonproliferation treaty.
ex.zh: 許多國家簽署了一項防止核武擴散條約。

ex.en: The meeting focused on nonproliferation and global safety.
ex.zh: 這場會議的焦點是防止擴散與全球安全。

ex.en: The nomadic tribes moved with their sheep across the plains.
ex.zh: 遊牧部落帶著羊群在平原上遷移。

ex.en: After college, he lived a nomadic life, traveling from city to city.
ex.zh: 大學畢業後，他過著四處漂泊的生活，從一個城市到另一個城市。

ex.en: The children ran noisily down the hallway.
ex.zh: 孩子們吵吵鬧鬧地跑過走廊。

ex.en: He ate his soup noisily, which annoyed his sister.
ex.zh: 他吃湯時發出很大的聲音，惹得姊姊不高興。

ex.en: She found a quiet nook in the library to read.
ex.zh: 她在圖書館找到一個安靜的角落看書。

ex.en: The cottage has a cozy nook by the window.
ex.zh: 這間小屋的窗邊有個舒適的小角落。

ex.en: Smiling is a common form of nonverbal communication.
ex.zh: 微笑是常見的非語言溝通方式。

ex.en: Babies use nonverbal signals long before they can talk.
ex.zh: 嬰兒在會說話之前很久就會用非語言的訊號溝通。

ex.en: The gang gained notoriety for its crimes.
ex.zh: 這個幫派因為犯罪而惡名昭彰。

ex.en: He gained notoriety after the scandal.
ex.zh: 那次醜聞之後，他變得惡名遠播。

ex.en: The group is nonpartisan and supports no political party.
ex.zh: 這個團體是無黨派的，不支持任何政黨。

ex.en: The judge asked for a nonpartisan review of the case.
ex.zh: 法官要求對此案進行超黨派的審查。

ex.en: Owls are nocturnal birds that hunt at night.
ex.zh: 貓頭鷹是夜行性的鳥類，在夜間獵食。

ex.en: Many nocturnal animals sleep during the day.
ex.zh: 許多夜行性動物白天都在睡覺。

ex.en: He has a nocturnal habit of working until three in the morning.
ex.zh: 他有夜間工作到凌晨三點的習慣。

ex.en: The city is quiet except for the occasional nocturnal sound.
ex.zh: 除了偶爾傳來的夜間聲響，城市很安靜。

ex.en: Turn the nozzle to change the spray from mist to a jet.
ex.zh: 轉動噴嘴，可以把水霧改成水柱。

ex.en: He pointed the hose nozzle at the flower bed.
ex.zh: 他把水管的噴嘴對準花圃。

ex.en: He was a nonconformist who never followed fashion.
ex.zh: 他是個不隨波逐流的人，從不追隨流行。

ex.en: The school was proud of its nonconformists and their new ideas.
ex.zh: 學校以那些不從眾又有新想法的學生為榮。

ex.en: She has a nonconformist style of dressing.
ex.zh: 她的穿著風格不落俗套。

ex.en: His nonconformist views surprised the committee.
ex.zh: 他不從俗的看法讓委員會很驚訝。

ex.en: The two countries want to normalize their relations.
ex.zh: 兩國希望使彼此的關係正常化。

ex.en: We should not normalize rude behavior at work.
ex.zh: 我們不該把工作上的無禮行為視為理所當然。

ex.en: You need to normalize the data before comparing the results.
ex.zh: 比較結果之前，你得先把資料標準化。

ex.en: The software will normalize all the file names automatically.
ex.zh: 這個軟體會自動將所有檔名統一格式。

ex.en: Noxious fumes filled the room after the chemicals mixed.
ex.zh: 化學藥品混合後，有毒的煙霧充滿了房間。

ex.en: Workers wore masks to avoid breathing noxious gases.
ex.zh: 工人戴上口罩以避免吸入有害氣體。

ex.en: The birds fly northward every spring.
ex.zh: 鳥兒每年春天都向北飛。

ex.en: We drove northward along the coast.
ex.zh: 我們沿著海岸向北開車。

ex.en: The northward road was closed because of snow.
ex.zh: 往北的道路因下雪而封閉。

ex.en: They began a northward journey at dawn.
ex.zh: 他們在黎明時展開了向北的旅程。

ex.en: Babies get all their nourishment from milk.
ex.zh: 嬰兒所有的營養都來自奶。

ex.en: Plants take nourishment from the soil.
ex.zh: 植物從土壤中吸取養分。

nomad.zh: 遊牧民族的一員；流浪者

ex.en: The nomads moved their tents to find fresh grass for the sheep.
ex.zh: 遊牧民族搬動帳篷，為羊群尋找新鮮的草。

ex.en: After years of travel, she called herself a nomad with no fixed home.
ex.zh: 旅行多年後，她稱自己是個沒有固定住處的流浪者。

ex.en: The cowboy threw a noose over the horse's neck.
ex.zh: 牛仔把一個套索拋到馬的脖子上。

ex.en: The hunter set a noose to catch small animals.
ex.zh: 獵人設下套索來捕捉小動物。

nondescript.zh: 毫無特色的；平淡無奇的

ex.en: He lived in a nondescript house at the end of the street.
ex.zh: 他住在街尾一間毫無特色的房子裡。

ex.en: The man wore a nondescript gray coat and blended into the crowd.
ex.zh: 那名男子穿著一件不起眼的灰色外套，融入人群中。

ex.en: The company is nominally owned by his wife, but he runs it.
ex.zh: 這間公司名義上是他太太的，實際上由他經營。

ex.en: The meeting was nominally open to all, but few people knew about it.
ex.zh: 這場會議名義上對所有人開放，但知道的人很少。

ex.en: Many people love Nordic design for its simple style.
ex.zh: 許多人喜歡北歐設計簡約的風格。

ex.en: We are planning a trip to the Nordic countries next summer.
ex.zh: 我們打算明年夏天去北歐國家旅行。

ex.en: Many Nordics enjoy spending time in saunas.
ex.zh: 許多北歐人喜歡泡桑拿。

ex.en: The festival welcomed visitors, including several Nordics from Sweden.
ex.zh: 這個節慶歡迎各地遊客，其中有幾位來自瑞典的北歐人。

ex.en: A nova suddenly became bright in the night sky.
ex.zh: 夜空中突然有一顆新星變亮了。

ex.en: Astronomers watched the nova fade over several weeks.
ex.zh: 天文學家觀察那顆新星在幾週內逐漸變暗。

ex.en: The prize had only a notional value of one dollar.
ex.zh: 這份獎品只有名義上一塊錢的價值。

ex.en: It was a notional plan that had never been tested.
ex.zh: 那只是個理論上的計畫，從來沒被測試過。

ex.en: Life slowly returned to normalcy after the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨過後，生活漸漸恢復常態。

ex.en: They hoped for a sense of normalcy after the move.
ex.zh: 他們希望搬家後能恢復正常生活的感覺。

ex.en: The nobleman lived in a huge castle.
ex.zh: 那位貴族住在一座巨大的城堡裡。

ex.en: In the story, a poor girl marries a young nobleman.
ex.zh: 故事中，一個貧窮女孩嫁給了一位年輕貴族。

ex.en: Noncompliance with safety rules may result in a fine.
ex.zh: 不遵守安全規定可能會被罰款。

ex.en: The report pointed out the company's noncompliance with the law.
ex.zh: 報告指出這家公司未遵守法律規定。

ex.en: He stared into the nothingness of the night sky.
ex.zh: 他凝視著夜空中的一片虛無。

ex.en: Some philosophers think deeply about nothingness and existence.
ex.zh: 有些哲學家會深入思考虛無與存在。

ex.en: The two countries talked about the normalization of relations.
ex.zh: 兩國談到關係正常化。

ex.en: Data normalization makes the numbers easier to compare.
ex.zh: 資料正規化讓數字更容易比較。

ex.en: The nominated actors sat together at the ceremony.
ex.zh: 被提名的演員們在典禮上坐在一起。

ex.en: Three nominated books made the final list.
ex.zh: 三本被提名的書進入了最後名單。

ex.en: Chemistry has its own system of nomenclature.
ex.zh: 化學有自己的命名系統。

ex.en: The nomenclature in this field is hard for beginners.
ex.zh: 這個領域的專業術語對初學者來說很難。

ex.en: She wrote the phone number on a notepad by the phone.
ex.zh: 她把電話號碼寫在電話旁的便條本上。

ex.en: I keep a small notepad in my bag for quick ideas.
ex.zh: 我的包包裡放了一本小記事本，用來記下突發的想法。

nonviolence.zh: 非暴力；不使用暴力的主張

ex.en: The group believes in nonviolence and solves problems through talking.
ex.zh: 這個團體主張非暴力，用對話解決問題。

ex.en: Many people admire her commitment to nonviolence.
ex.zh: 許多人敬佩她對非暴力的堅持。

ex.en: The teacher explained nonviolence to the class with a simple example.
ex.zh: 老師用一個簡單的例子向全班說明什麼是非暴力。

ex.en: She wrote a novella about a lonely lighthouse keeper.
ex.zh: 她寫了一部關於孤獨燈塔管理員的中篇小說。

ex.en: The novella is shorter than a novel but longer than a short story.
ex.zh: 中篇小說比長篇短，卻比短篇長。

ex.en: The paint is nontoxic, so it is safe for children.
ex.zh: 這種顏料無毒，對孩子是安全的。

ex.en: We use nontoxic cleaning products at home.
ex.zh: 我們家裡使用無毒的清潔用品。

nonsignificant.zh: 不顯著的；無重大意義的

ex.en: The difference between the two groups was nonsignificant.
ex.zh: 兩組之間的差異並不顯著。

ex.en: Most of the results were nonsignificant, so we ran the study again.
ex.zh: 大部分結果都不顯著，所以我們重新做了一次研究。

ex.en: Nonmembers pay a higher entrance fee.
ex.zh: 非會員要付較高的入場費。

ex.en: As a nonmember, you cannot vote at the meeting.
ex.zh: 身為非會員，你不能在會議上投票。

ex.en: The instructions were so nonsensical that nobody could follow them.
ex.zh: 這些說明荒謬到沒有人能照著做。

ex.en: He gave a nonsensical answer and everyone laughed.
ex.zh: 他給了個莫名其妙的答案，大家都笑了。

ex.en: A cold northerly wind blew across the lake.
ex.zh: 一陣寒冷的北風吹過湖面。

ex.en: We drove in a northerly direction for two hours.
ex.zh: 我們朝北方開了兩個小時的車。

ex.en: He shrugged nonchalantly and walked away.
ex.zh: 他若無其事地聳聳肩就走開了。

ex.en: She nonchalantly ate her lunch while everyone argued.
ex.zh: 大家爭吵時，她滿不在乎地吃著午餐。

ex.en: She wrote a short thank-you on blue notepaper.
ex.zh: 她在藍色信紙上寫了一張簡短的感謝信。

ex.en: I keep a pad of notepaper next to the phone.
ex.zh: 我在電話旁放了一本便條紙。

ex.en: The doctor found a small nodule in her thyroid.
ex.zh: 醫生在她的甲狀腺發現一個小結節。

ex.en: A nodule on the root helps the plant take in nitrogen.
ex.zh: 根上的小根瘤幫助植物吸收氮。

ex.en: This is the northernmost town in the country.
ex.zh: 這是全國最北邊的城鎮。

ex.en: The northernmost point of the island has a small lighthouse.
ex.zh: 島嶼最北端有一座小燈塔。

ex.en: The class schedule is posted on the noticeboard.
ex.zh: 課表貼在佈告欄上。

ex.en: Someone pinned a lost-cat flyer to the noticeboard.
ex.zh: 有人把尋貓啟事釘在佈告欄上。

ex.en: He gave a nonchalant shrug and walked away.
ex.zh: 他若無其事地聳聳肩就走開了。

ex.en: She stayed nonchalant even though the test was difficult.
ex.zh: 儘管考試很難，她還是一派輕鬆。

ex.en: He no longer works at the bank downtown.
ex.zh: 他已經不在市區那間銀行工作了。

ex.en: This bus route is no longer in service.
ex.zh: 這條公車路線已經停駛了。

ex.en: I can no longer eat spicy food because of my stomach.
ex.zh: 因為胃不好，我已經不能再吃辣了。

ex.en: Don't worry about the spilled water. It's no big deal.
ex.zh: 別在意打翻的水，沒什麼大不了的。

ex.en: Being five minutes late is no big deal for me.
ex.zh: 遲到五分鐘對我來說沒什麼大不了。

ex.en: He said losing the game was no big deal.
ex.zh: 他說輸了比賽沒什麼大不了。
